measurements.unit: UTF-8 bytes; not tokens or measured latency
measurements.slice_limit: Illustrative slices omit actor-specific runtime/proof/source appendices; not complete execution packs or a speed claim.

findings.observation: All five prompts require fifteen full documents including the canonical source and repeated projections, then their WPs.
findings.change: Generate COMMON plus exact actor/session packs from canonical selectors. Preserve full criteria and cross-cutting invariants without requiring duplicate representations.

findings.observation: replace_section and body appear as literal headings, and generic orchestration is duplicated with specific orchestration.
findings.change: Use replacement semantics in the generator and emit one operational section per session.

findings.observation: Primary API/source receipts exist but the initial reading path does not offer a small reusable discovery index.
findings.change: Generate source index keyed by repo/commit/path/blob/question. Writers still inspect changed source and dependencies; runtime authorization/capacity cannot be cached as static facts.

findings.observation: Producer ownership and incremental handoffs already exist; a second conceptual framework would duplicate planning. Checkpoint wording can be operationalized without waiting for entire WPs.
findings.change: Generate producer reuse index and deduplicated integration queue. Consume identified increments, preserving S0 windows, owner boundaries and real-producer acceptance.

findings.observation: The five-session roster is not evidence of five independent sessions actually created by one supervisor. A four-slot collaboration tree cannot be multiplied by nesting.
findings.change: Compile an attributed supervisor/session/job launch protocol, require observed capacity scope and transport, and distinguish Git ledger from a session creation mechanism.

context_compiler.implementation: Extend the existing render_plan.py; no new orchestration runtime
actor_pack_fields: all assigned tasks with complete local axioms/checks
complete five-family axioms of assigned WPs
full contracts read/provided and relevant dependency exports
incoming/outgoing handoffs and exact consumer targets
relevant coverage rows, numeric oracles and proof-map rows
proof owners and current candidate requirements
context_compiler.reviewer_pack_rule: Scope includes assigned complete review surface and cross-boundary sources; do not limit reviewers to writer-owned files or inherit other reviewers' conclusions.
validation: All 74 tasks assigned to valid writer leases
All five axiom families preserved at campaign/WP/task
All relevant criteria and dependency sources reachable
No truncation to meet byte budgets
context_compiler.size_rule: Report measured generated bytes; split large packs by declared phase/job with a complete index, never truncate criteria.

supervisor_protocol.default: S0 plus S1-S4; S0 keeps its existing integration allocation; no sixth coordinator
supervisor_protocol.parameter_n: N requires a validated roster/task/lease/slot schedule against observed backend capacity; not an automatic speed multiplier
admission: observed instance IDs and launch acknowledgements
tool/access availability without new corporate access
supervisor_protocol.transport: Use native thread lifecycle/events only when exposed and observed. GitHub remains durable receipts/commits; it is not a mechanism for creating sessions.
supervisor_protocol.capacity_warning: Current collaboration tree advertises four total slots including root; child nesting does not establish twenty independent slots.
supervisor_protocol.no_choice: Executors receive fixed identity and assignments; do not choose a slice or compete for common files.

deduplication.reuse_limit: Shared structure and existing modules only; preserve operation-specific handlers/semantics, distinct skill content and all positive/negative proof routes. No new business DSL or fake generic adapter.
deduplication.integration: S0 one queue, within existing time allocation; critical native handoffs first; batch by consumable increment, not checklist row; do not delay 13/14/15/16 native handoffs for larger batches.
deduplication.acceptance: Fixtures permit isolated construction only; no final acceptance until real producers and consumers are integrated.

recovery.event_policy: Update on material state change and required checkpoint; avoid repeated narrative and full-plan copies.
recovery.transfer: Silence is not proof of death. Close/fence the previous writer through supported mechanisms before granting a new lease. Continue disjoint work when liveness is uncertain.
recovery.resume: Read checkpoint and delta from received head; preserve accepted work, revalidate affected facts, continue remaining tasks without broad restart.

dod: Generated prompts/packs are attributed, hashed and checked; every task has executable writer, outputs, consumer and receipt; all original criteria remain complete.
invariants: Single canonical source; full scope and gates; one writer per path; observed capacity; current authorization; real-runtime acceptance; independent reviewers; no inherited PASS across unproven changes.
quality_standards: Direct prompts with no implementation-key headings; exact producer/consumer/export; immutable reuse is hashed; communicate change/impact/next step; avoid new abstractions unless required.
completeness_criteria: Preserve 74 tasks, five axiom families, all leases, 19 handoffs, 18 skills, 39 routes, six resident proofs and relevant cross-boundary invariants.
success_criteria: Measure actual reading volume, repeated discovery, duplicate receipts, ready-to-consumed latency, writer conflicts and coordination time; target zero duplicated producers/integrations/collisions; claim minute savings only after observation.

remaining_uncertainties: Actual native independent-session spawning and capacity
Final pack sizes after all specific appendices
Actual implementation effort; no two-hour guarantee is established by this proposal
